newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX NIKKEI FUTURES END HIGHER, GAINS PRECARIOUS.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX NIKKEI FUTURES END HIGHER, GAINS PRECARIOUS.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures finished firmer on short-covering ahead of the weekend on Friday, but dealers said contiuned poor sentiment meant further gains would prove difficult.
Nikkei 225 September futures bounced back from an intra-day low of 19,250 to end at 19,635, 265 points above its previous close.
Dealers said the September Nikkei would face resistance initially at 19,700 and then at 19,800.
"If we see a (downward) correction in the dollar/yen, there could be some follow through selling on the Nikkei," a trader at a U.S. futures house said.
The dollar was quoted at 118.50/60 yen at 0745 GMT in Tokyo, near its day high.
The trader said a breach of the 19,250 support level would expose the September Nikkei to a further drop towards 18,950.
Taiwan stock index futures ended near their day highs as Taipei shares recovered from a three-day slump on strong buying of key electronics sector shares.
The August MSCI contract added 6.9 to end at 416.6 on volume of 1,996 lots.
